name: ClassPass
description: ClassPass class discovery and availability: find studios and class occurrences near a point for a date, read studio details and class types, a studio's schedule for a day, a single class occurrence with its availability status and displayed credit price, resolve locations and list markets. Anonymous same-origin JSON API of classpass.com; read-only, no reservations. Prices are ClassPass credits as displayed to anonymous visitors; member pricing is login-only and not returned.

tools.name: Location
tools.description: Turn a city or address into latitude/longitude for search_schedules / search_venues.

options.name: place_id
options.about: A `place_id` from a previous `query` answer. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$.

options.name: query
options.about: Free text place name; mutually exclusive with `place_id`.

response.about: Resolve a place: with `query`, the site's location autocomplete (place names with Google place ids); with `place_id`, the place's coordinates, timezone and the search radius the site uses for it.

fields.name: predictions
fields.about: Autocomplete matches (null in `details` mode). May be empty for an unknown query.

tools.name: Markets
tools.description: Coverage check and a starting coordinate for search_schedules / search_venues without a geocoder.

options.name: country_code
options.about: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 filter (e.g. `GB`). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2}$.

response.about: The ClassPass markets (metropolitan areas): id, alias, name, country, currency, timezone and the default map centre the site uses for each, optionally filtered by country.

fields.name: total
fields.about: Markets the site listed before the country filter.

tools.name: Schedule
tools.description: Detail for an `id` from search_schedules or venue_schedule.

options.name: url
options.about: A pasted https://classpass.com/classes/{venue}/{class}/{schedule_id} URL; alternative to `schedule_id`.

response.about: One class occurrence by schedule id (or its pasted /classes/ URL): class type, venue, start/end, instructor, availability status snapshot and displayed credit price.

fields.name: pricing
fields.about: How to read the `credits` values: ClassPass shows anonymous visitors a retail price in ClassPass credits, not money. Fees/taxes are not stated. Member-specific prices come from a login-only quote endpoint and are not returned.

fields.name: schedule
fields.about: One class occurrence (the site calls it a schedule).

tools.name: Search schedules
tools.description: Discovery of classes near a location on a date. Get coordinates from `location` or `markets`; pass a result's `id` to `schedule`, its `venue.id` to `venue` / `venue_schedule`.

options.name: cursor
options.about: `next_cursor` from a previous page; when given the other filters are taken from the cursor and must be omitted.

options.name: date
options.about: Calendar date in the venues' local zone: YYYY-MM-DD, or `today` / `tomorrow` (resolved in UTC). Required unless `cursor` is given. Pattern: ^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}|today|tomorrow)$.

options.name: end_time
options.about: Latest start, venue-local HH:MM. Pattern: ^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$.

options.name: latitude
options.about: Search centre. Required unless `cursor` is given.

options.name: longitude
options.about: longitude

options.name: max_results
options.about: Trim the page to this many results (the site pages by 50).

options.name: radius_km
options.about: Search radius in kilometres (the site's unit).

options.name: start_time
options.about: Earliest start, venue-local HH:MM. Pattern: ^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$.

options.name: tag_ids
options.about: Site tag ids to filter by (e.g. `activity-95` Strength Training); the `tags` of a venue list them.

options.name: vertical
options.about: vertical

response.about: Find class occurrences (schedules) around a point for one date, optionally within a venue-local time window and activity tags, 50 per page with a cursor. Each result carries the venue, class type, start/end (unix seconds + venue timezone), availability status snapshot and the credit price the site displays anonymously (null when it shows none).

fields.name: date
fields.about: The resolved date searched (YYYY-MM-DD); null on cursor pages, where the site carries it inside the cursor.

fields.name: location_name
fields.about: How the site names the area it resolved the coordinates to.

fields.name: next_cursor
fields.about: Opaque cursor for the next page; null when the site sent none (last page or empty result).

fields.name: pricing
fields.about: How to read the `credits` values: ClassPass shows anonymous visitors a retail price in ClassPass credits, not money. Fees/taxes are not stated. Member-specific prices come from a login-only quote endpoint and are not returned.

fields.name: search_url
fields.about: The site's canonical search page for these filters.

venues.description: Barry’s is an hour-long cardio and strength-building workout designed to help your body burn up to 1,000 calories thanks to their carefully crafted program that is as effective as it is fun. Their clients spend 25-30 minutes running on the treadmill and 25-30 minutes doing strength training, broken into rounds.
venues.name: Barry's

venues.description:
F45 Training is a revolutionary fitness program that combines cutting-edge technology with high-intensity group workouts to deliver maximum results in just 45 minutes. Our daily workouts  are designed for you to be able to attend multiple sessions per week. 

Mondays and Wednesdays: These cardio workouts use plyometric movements, timing and tempo to get your heart rate up and burn calories. Get ready to challenge yourself and build stamina!

Tuesdays, Thursdays and Sundays: We focus on building strength through resistance training. These workouts utilize your own body weight and weight-based equipment to help build and strengthen your muscles leading to increased muscle mass, improved bone density, and higher metabolism.

Fridays and Saturdays: These hybrid sessions combine cardio, resistance, agility, and core movements for an intense full-body workout that improves strength, endurance, and metabolism.

What to expect from your F45 experience: 

Expert guidance, motivation, and support from experienced coaches throughout each session
An effective way to achieve your fitness goals, with every class estimated to burn 400-800 calories, depending on the class. 
Innovative use of technology, including a video demonstration of the workout and an interval timer, to guide members seamlessly through their training session
A community of like-minded individuals who share a passion for health and fitness, creating a supportive and inclusive environment that motivates and inspires you to achieve your goals

Should I already be exercising regularly to attend? 
F45 is suitable for a wide range of individuals, regardless of fitness level or experience. Whether you're just starting on your fitness journey or you're a seasoned athlete, F45 workouts are designed to be able to work at your own pace. Our experienced coaches provide modifications and progressions for each exercise, ensuring that everyone in the class gets a challenging and effective workout.
venues.name: F45 Training

venues.description: BODYROK is a Pilates-inspired, 45-min, full body, strength training group class on the custom BODYROK reformer. Their hybrid Pilates sequences will have you plank, lunge, squeeze, pike, jump and push your body - the BODYROK experience is designed to create more energy and increase your metabolism, working for you even after you leave. Come ROK with them!
venues.name: BODYROK

venues.description:
Reformer & Tower Classes at KIN Kollective

Every movement tells a story and at KIN, we help you navigate it with intention. Our Reformer and Tower classes are designed to deepen your understanding of your body through Kinetic Intelligent Navigation: a method that emphasizes precision, mindful progression, and the seamless connection between strength and awareness.

On the Reformer, smooth-gliding carriages and finely tuned resistance systems create an environment where alignment and flow meet challenge. These classes build strength from the inside out, enhancing mobility, control, and grace with every sequence.

The Tower offers a uniquely upright experience, blending classical foundations with intelligent resistance work. Springs and bars provide multidirectional feedback, awakening stabilizers and refining posture as you explore dynamic movement pathways.

Each class is thoughtfully guided by KIN Navigators, expert instructors who lead with clarity, warmth, and an unwavering commitment to helping you move smarter. The result is a practice that’s grounded, elevated, and entirely your own.
venues.name: KIN Kollective Brooklyn Heights

venues.description:
Tangerine Yoga is a kickass community in Brooklyn where people can wind down, connect with others and enjoy a playful yoga practice that’s powered by the teachers.

We empower our teachers to lead a practice that is unique and true to their own style, providing experiences for every student - whether novice, intermediate or experienced. Coming from a variety of disciplines and backgrounds, our teachers are the heart and soul of Tangerine Yoga.

Most of our classes, including tangerine flow, are heated to 90 degrees - check class descriptions for temperatures. 

We provide mats & towels free of charge with every class. 

Make sure you arrive on time - late entry is not permitted 5 minutes after the class start time.
venues.name: Tangerine Yoga

fields.name: rating

fields.name: spots
fields.about: The site's `spots` field on the venue record, as stated; its meaning is not documented.

fields.name: tags
fields.about: The site's tag tree flattened: every tag and subtag with its id, name and parent id.
